cards.default: backgroundColor: bgCard, borderRadius: md12, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: border, padding: md16
cards.elevated: backgroundColor: bgCard, borderRadius: md16, shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: {width: 0, height: 4}, shadowOpacity: 0.3, shadowRadius: 8, elevation: 5

buttons.primary: backgroundColor: gold, borderRadius: full999, paddingHorizontal: lg24, paddingVertical: md16, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center'

HomeScreen.layout: SafeAreaView flex 1, ScrollView with vertical stacking and md16 padding.

components.name: Header
components.details: Row layout. User Avatar (left), Rank Points & Gold Coin counters (right) wrapped in bgLight pills.

components.name: League Hero
components.details: Large animated trophy centered, 'Champion' H2 text, gold progress bar against bgLight background.

components.name: Daily Quests Strip
components.details: Horizontal ScrollView of 3 compact cards. Card: icon, text, progress bar (blue). Claim button when full.

components.name: Featured Mode Card
components.details: Massive elevated card, background image overlay. Play button (Primary Gold).

components.name: Quick Stats Row
components.details: 3 columns: Wins, Coins, Streak. Using SpaceMono for numbers, muted labels.

components.name: Mode Cards
components.details: Aspect ratio 1:1, default card styling. Icon centered, Title bold white, Player count muted. Lock icon overlay if low level.

GameScreen.layout: Full screen flex 1, backgroundColor bg. High tension design.

components.name: VS Header
components.details: Flex row. Player Left (Avatar + Score), VS text center, Opponent Right (Avatar + Score).

components.name: Timer
components.details: Large circular SVG timer in center. Starts gold, turns red at 5s. Pulse scale animation.

components.name: Question Card
components.details: Elevated card bgCard. Top badge: Category. Difficulty dots (1-3). Question text H2 center aligned.

components.name: Answer Buttons
components.details: List of 4 buttons (A/B/C/D). Default bgLight. On press: scale down, turn blue. Correct: turn green. Wrong: turn red. Add 'Opponent answered' small avatar indicator.

components.name: Winner Announcement
components.details: Massive text display. Confetti animation overlay.

components.name: Rewards Breakdown
components.details: XP count-up animation, Coin count-up animation. Uses mono font.

components.name: Rank Progress
components.details: League badge icon, progress bar showing + points filling up.

components.name: Action Buttons
components.details: Rematch (Primary Gold), Home (Secondary).

components.name: Avatar Section
components.details: Large avatar, equipped abstract frame, title badge underneath. Level XP bar below.

components.name: Stats Grid
components.details: 2x2 grid view. W/L Ratio, Accuracy %, Best Streak, Avg Response Time.

components.name: Recent Matches
components.details: FlatList view. W/L indicator, Opponent name, Score diff.

components.name: Tabs
components.details: Horizontal ScrollView: All, Frames, Avatars, Effects.

components.name: Item Card
components.details: bgCard, item image, price in Gold. 'Equip' button if owned.

components.name: Tabs
components.details: Global, Country, Friends.

components.name: Rank Row
components.details: Rank # (Mono), Avatar, Name, League Badge, Points.

animation_guidelines.general: Snappy, spring-based animations. Use React Native Reanimated.
animation_guidelines.buttons: Scale down to 0.95 on press, scale up to 1 on release using spring physics.
animation_guidelines.count_ups: Use a tween for numbers over 1.5 seconds. (Coins, XP).
animation_guidelines.feedback: Horizontal shake animation on wrong answer. Pulse scale on correct answer.
animation_guidelines.level_up: Screen flash white 0.2s, then show full screen badge pop with confetti.

image_urls.description: Gold lines dark texture for premium cards

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a testID attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: This is a React Native Expo app, NOT a web app. Therefore, use StyleSheet, View, Text, TouchableOpacity, and React Native Animated/Reanimated.
Do NOT use HTML tags (div, span) or standard Tailwind CSS web classes. Map the design system to React Native StyleSheet objects.
Apply the exact color hex codes and spacing values provided in this JSON.
Use 'react-native-svg' for the circular countdown timer and icons.
For the custom font 'Nunito' and 'SpaceMono', assume they are loaded via Expo Google Fonts.
Use react-native-reanimated or react-native-animatable for the juice (confetti, shake, spring scales).
Enforce `testID` (NOT data-testid) on React Native elements like TouchableOpacity and Text nodes holding critical data.
